cause: Training/serving skew on f5 only: features f1-f4 are byte-identical across the 200 overlapping entities (mean and max absolute difference = 0), but f5 diverges. The relationship is exact across all 200 rows: training_f5 = ln(1 + serving_f5), i.e. serving_f5 = exp(training_f5) - 1 (max error ~6e-7, floating-point rounding). This means the training pipeline applies a log1p (natural log of 1+x) transformation when computing f5, while the online serving path serves the raw, untransformed value. The skew is a missing/inconsistent log1p transform in the serving feature computation.
